acceptanceCriteria: `go test -count=1 ./internal/localcompletion/` passes with TMPDIR under /var/folders and with a non-symlinked TMPDIR.
The production local-state-symlink refusal is unchanged.
body: Context: Go 1.27.1, Darwin arm64 and GitHub macos-15, 2026-10-05, release candidate da78c1572211a85e6c9944adb98350d69964eb9b. With the default TMPDIR under /var/folders (/var -> /private/var), TestAggregateExclusiveLateCancelRemovesStage (storage_test.go:525), TestAggregateExclusiveLateHoldRetainsStage (:555) and TestAggregateQualificationActualIOFailures/{write,close} (:1600) fail with local-state-symlink because the product correctly refuses symlinked local-state ancestors. Same class as V1-0753 and V1-0840; masked on candidate 1 by the gate's earlier failures. Expected: tests pass under the default TMPDIR. Fix: a package TestMain that resolves TMPDIR, leaving the production refusal intact.

completion.reason: localcompletion symlinked-TMPDIR fixture fixed in candidate 3; internal/localcompletion passes on hosted macos-15 and locally; production refusal unchanged. Hosted Release gates run 37466658604 on b7b21205 (published as v1.0.0-rc.2) passed full-gate on macos-15 and ubuntu-24.04 (make gate incl. cross-vet and go-test), and the local make gate passed on darwin/arm64 with the default symlinked TMPDIR; the SRR-V1 readiness record (sha256 above, corvint-release-evidence/1.0.0-rc.2-b7b21205) was built and verified.

title: localcompletion tests fail under the macOS default symlinked TMPDIR (local-state-symlink)
